messages:
incident-bot: Pager: Elevated 5xx rate on model-runtime-prod-us-west (service=model-runner, metric=5xx_rate, window=5m) -- current 5xx=9.8% > threshold 5% :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Triggered runbook runbook://runtime-5xx-pager (severity=sev2). Oncall: @maria_k.
maria_k: I'm on it, joining. Seeing increased retry rates from gateway and a cluster of segfault traces in runner logs. Starting investigation.
jordan_s: I can help correlate deploys, any recent model or runtime changes?
maria_k: No deploys in past 30m according to deploy-bot. There was a config change to kernel-selection flags ~45m ago but it was toggled only for canary.
eng_runtime: copying relevant logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T02:03:11Z] model-runner[pid=2145]: error: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f9c2a12 kernel_quantized_attention+0x1a3
[2026-03-17T02:03:11Z] model-runner[pid=2145]: backtrace: /opt/redwood/runtime/kernel_quantized_attention.so(+0x1a3)
[2026-03-17T02:03:11Z] kernel: Out-of-memory: Killed process 2145 (model-runner)
```

maria_k: Pattern: OOM followed by segfault in quantized attention kernel on GPUs with NVidia 4090 image. Affected pool: model-pool-qs-02.
sam_t: I'm oncall next, pinging so I can take lead if needed.
sre_lead: @maria_k quick ask — can we safely route traffic to fallback variant (non-quantized) while we troubleshoot? That should avoid the kernel path.
maria_k: Preparing reroute. Initiating policy: route model-family v2 -> v2-nq (non-quant) for prod-us-west.
eng_runtime: Command we ran: `rdwctl route set --pool model-pool-qs-02 --fallback v2-nq --weight 100 --reason "segfault/oom"`
eng_runtime: Also scaling pool model-pool-qs-02 by +2 nodes as emergency buffer: `rdwctl pool scale model-pool-qs-02 --delta 2`
support_ai: Customer impact note: multiple customers reporting 502s and timeouts; highest impact: Acme Corp (20% of their calls showing 502s), some increased latency for free-tier endpoints.
jordan_s: Filing interim status to postmortem tracker and notify CS to reach out to worst-impacted customers.
maria_k: After reroute, 5xx dropped to ~1.6% within 90s. Gateway errors decreased but some residual failures from in-flight requests.
sam_t: Good. We should isolate root cause: looks like quantized attention kernel memory growth under certain sequence-length distributions. Any repro?
eng_runtime: We reproduced locally by sending long-context prompts (~12k tokens) with batch size 8 on quantized kernels — memory spike then segfault. Instrumenting KV cache stats and attention workspace allocation now.
sre_lead: Action items: 1) keep fallback routing until fix validated (owner: maria_k). 2) roll back kernel flag on canary if it's enabled (owner: eng_runtime). 3) gather heap/profile traces from affected hosts (owner: sam_t). 4) post incident update for customers (owner: support_ai).
maria_k: Handoff note: I need to go offline in 15m for scheduled meeting, handing primary to @sam_t. Full context in thread.
sam_t: Taking over. I'll keep the fallback in place and coordinate hotfix. If we can produce an urgent build with a patched attention allocator, we can canary to a single host.
eng_runtime: Quick mitigation possibility: disable quantized attention kernel selection globally for the pool via feature flag: `rdwctl feature disable quant-kernel-v2 --scope pool:model-pool-qs-02` — this is lower-risk than a code rollback.
sam_t: Do it.
eng_runtime: Done. Feature flag disabled at 02:12:48Z.
maria_k: Leaving detailed notes in incident tracker and adding logs link: https://logs.redwood.internal/streams/3102467890 (internal).
support_ai: Notifying top 10 customers with templated status update, will call out Acme with higher urgency.
sre_lead: If the kernel team can push a patch today we can revert fallback later. Keep me updated on trace artifacts.
eng_runtime: Uploading core dumps + coredump metadata to /artifacts/incident-3102467890.tar.gz (internal).
sam_t: Current status at 02:23Z: fallback routing active, 5xx ~1.3%, scaling +2 remains, feature flag disabled. I will own follow-through until full mitigation; will hand back to oncall after verification.
maria_k: Thanks @sam_t. If anything spikes, tag me.
sam_t: ETA for next status update: +30m.
incident-bot: Runbook update: incident-3102467890 created and assigned to sam_t.
support_ai: Logged customer comms and CS outreach checklist.
eng_runtime: Started bisect to find commit that introduced allocator regression (if any). Early signs point to kernel memory path, not model weights.
sam_t: Handoff summary (for next oncall): fallback routing in place -> routing key v2 -> v2-nq, feature flag quant-kernel disabled on pool model-pool-qs-02, pool scaled +2, core dumps collected, customer comms in progress.
sam_t: marking this thread as in-progress; will update when we have a patch or revert.
incident-bot: Pager closed by sam_t (ack=1) at 02:30:45Z. Follow-up required: root cause analysis and hotfix deployment (owner: eng_runtime).
